'''''The Essays of [[Willim of Maneches]]''''' is a popular book of philosophy written in ancient times before the [[New Era]].{{ref/book|twotc|The Essays of Willim of Maneches|companion|Willim of Maneches, The Essays of}} [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] saw a copy of the book located in the library of the [[Queen's Blessing]] inn in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|1|36}} [[Egwene]] and [[Elayne]] located a second copy within the home of [[Mother Guenna]], a [[Wise Woman]] living in [[Tear]].{{ref/book|3|49}} Elayne spent some time reading it while staying in her home.{{ref/book|3|49}} [[Loial]] also owns a copy of the book in his collection.{{ref/book|10|24}}

Willim's works influenced a number of later writers, including the [[Saldaea]]n philosopher [[Shivena Kayenzi]] who claimed that all reality was an illusion.{{ref/book|0|8}}{{ref||companion}} Lectures on his essays are taught to [[Novice]]s and [[Accepted]] while they matriculate in the [[White Tower]]. When [[Moiraine Damodred]] was an Accepted, she was once questioned by [[Meilyn Arganya]] regarding Willim's influence over Shivena.{{ref/book|0|8}}
